focus: Implementation correctness and failure integrity, not student superiority

fixes.issue: Failed evaluation retry could leave a stale complete result
fixes.fix: Atomic running/failed/complete records; per-result exclusive lock; preserve input files; exceptions and interrupts propagate with failed status

fixes.issue: Teacher evaluation accepted invalid ATT and did not require completed training audit
fixes.fix: Require completed training audit and finite positive ATT before committing; JSON rejects all nonfinite numeric outputs

fixes.issue: Collection could publish a partial gzip file or overwrite an existing trajectory
fixes.fix: Publish a fully serialized temporary gzip only after successful completion; reject existing output paths

fixes.issue: Unknown deployment feature contract could silently use different normalization or direction semantics
fixes.fix: Reject unsupported named contracts; retain documented legacy/default and known raw/normalized contracts

fixes.issue: Inherited legacy API backend could override JSON provider and bypass offline cache handling
fixes.fix: Public config provider takes precedence; legacy COMP route refuses readonly/offline requests before backend import

preserved: utility formula execution for valid artifacts
limits: No paid API calls in this audit; provider availability is not established.
Tests exercise concrete normal and failure paths; they do not prove absence of all possible bugs.
SIGKILL or power loss may leave status running; this is intentionally not counted as complete.
Input alias checks run before result writes to preserve source files.
